name: Reprism
purpose: Support exercise decisions through measured movement, accumulated records, and interpretable statistical feedback.
audience: People who want training assistance and data-informed improvement.

philosophies.statement: Provide a stable reference that supports a person's training.
Summarize repeated records instead of reacting to one isolated observation.
Connect measured differences to an understandable next adjustment.

rules.statement: Record inputs and statistical gain may change the inner trace but must leave the outer R reference unchanged.
Use an explicitly computed statistical summary to construct the internal curve.
Maintain at least 1px nominal trace weight and curved-lane clearance at a 28px wordmark height.
Label the numerical inputs as illustrative design values, without implying clinical validation or actual exercise outcomes.
Design R and eprism as one signature: related strokes, bowls, proportions and optical spacing within the application palette.

typography: Original geometric lettering: shared symbol/letter construction with disclosed optical adjustments.
assumptions: The logo expresses data-informed support; audience interpretation remains a design judgment.
